title: Gemini Antigravity builds photoreal Bugatti W16 Three.js scene in four minutes
summary: Demo post showing Gemini 3.7 Flash High inside Google Antigravity generating a Bugatti W16 engine in Three.js in about four minutes, with mechanically accurate internals and a photoreal exterior. Serves as a capability benchmark for agent-built mechanical 3D heroes.
question_it_answers: Can a fast Gemini agent in Antigravity produce inspectable mechanical Three.js equipment scenes for marketing?

claims.text: Gemini 3.7 Flash High in Antigravity produced the scene in roughly four minutes.
claims.evidence: it created this in ~4 mins - pretty fast and perfect
claims.subject: web-3d-scenes

claims.text: Output is a Bugatti W16 with mechanically accurate internals and photoreal exterior in Three.js.
